title: chore(backend): implement core shared utils (password, jwt, async-handler, date, geo)
description: Bundle the five small, pure-function utility files: password.js (bcrypt wrapper), jwt.js (sign/verify), async-handler.js, date.js (overlap-range helpers for bookings), geo.js (distance calc for search).
acceptance_criteria: All five exported and unit-testable in isolation · async-handler correctly forwards thrown errors to Express's error middleware · date.js overlap function has at least one test case for adjacent (non-overlapping) ranges.

title: feat(backend): implement Prisma client singleton and logger
description: config/database.js (single shared PrismaClient instance, not one per request) and config/logger.js.
acceptance_criteria: Importing database.js from two different files returns the same client instance · app logs a startup message confirming DB connectivity.

title: feat(backend): implement JWT authentication middleware
description: authenticate.js — verifies Authorization: Bearer header, attaches req.user, returns 401 per api-reference.md error shape on missing/invalid token.
acceptance_criteria: Missing header → 401 · Expired/invalid token → 401 · Valid token → req.user populated with id and role.

title: feat(backend): implement role authorization + ownership guard middleware
description: authorize.js (role check, e.g. ADMIN-only routes) and ownership-guard.js (does req.user.id own the resource being mutated).
acceptance_criteria: Non-admin hitting an admin route → 403 · Non-owner mutating another user's listing/booking → 403 · Owner succeeds.

title: feat(backend): implement request validation middleware
description: validate-request.js running a module's *.validation.js (zod) schema before the controller, returning 400 with details per api-reference.md's error shape.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid body → 400 with field-level details · Valid body passes through unchanged to controller.

title: chore(backend): implement rate limiter and request logger middleware
description: rate-limiter.js (apply to /auth/* and other write-heavy routes) and request-logger.js.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated rapid login attempts get throttled with a clear error · every request logs method/path/status/duration.

title: feat(backend): implement multer upload middleware + object storage config
description: upload.js (multer config: file type/size limits) and config/storage.js (object storage SDK setup — pick a provider, e.g. S3-compatible or local disk for dev).
acceptance_criteria: Rejects files over the size limit and non-image types for image uploads · returns a usable file reference/URL on success.

title: chore(backend): stand up local Postgres and verify prisma migrate dev
description: Get docker-compose up -d db (or equivalent) running, run the first real migration, confirm tables match schema.prisma.
acceptance_criteria: npx prisma migrate dev completes clean · npx prisma studio shows all expected tables.

title: chore(backend): apply and verify the booking overlap exclusion constraint
description: Apply prisma/migrations/manual/booking_overlap_constraint.sql to the dev DB, confirm btree_gist extension installs, write a manual test proving an overlapping insert is rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Attempting to insert two overlapping CONFIRMED bookings on the same item raises exclusion_violation · non-overlapping bookings succeed.

title: chore(backend): write prisma/seed.js with realistic sample data
description: Seed categories, a few test users (one ADMIN), sample listings, so frontend devs aren't blocked on empty data.
acceptance_criteria: npm run prisma:seed populates enough data for the browse page to show real results · idempotent (safe to re-run).

title: feat(backend): implement POST /auth/register
description: Per api-reference.md 'Auth' section — exact request/response shape is already locked, don't renegotiate it here.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate email → 409 · password hashed via password.js, never stored plain · response matches { token, user } exactly · unit test for both cases.

title: feat(backend): implement POST /auth/login
acceptance_criteria: Wrong password and non-existent email both return the same 401 message (no user enumeration) · correct credentials return { token, user } matching the documented shape.

title: feat(backend): implement GET /auth/me and POST /auth/logout
acceptance_criteria: /me returns 401 without a token, correct user shape with one · /logout returns { success: true }.

title: feat(backend): implement GET /users/:id and PATCH /users/me
acceptance_criteria: Public GET never returns email/phone · PATCH only updates fields present in the request body · PATCH requires auth and only allows self-edit.

title: feat(backend): implement identity verification endpoints
acceptance_criteria: POST sets status to PENDING · GET /me returns current status · both require auth.

title: feat(backend): implement GET /categories + seed default categories
acceptance_criteria: Returns flat list with parentId per contract · seeded with real categories matching the design (Electronics, Cameras, Tools, Camping, Event Gear, Furniture, etc.).

title: feat(backend): implement listing CRUD (POST, PATCH, DELETE, GET /listings/:id)
acceptance_criteria: POST defaults status to DRAFT · PATCH/DELETE require ownership (BE-04) · DELETE soft-deletes to ARCHIVED, never hard-deletes · GET on a DRAFT listing is 403 for non-owners.

title: feat(backend): implement GET /listings/mine
acceptance_criteria: Returns paginated own listings including DRAFT status, matches the pagination envelope from pagination.js.

title: feat(backend): implement POST /listings/:id/images
acceptance_criteria: Multipart upload, owner-only, returns image URLs per contract.

title: feat(backend): implement GET /search per the documented contract
description: Includes the two revisions made during the frontend build: category, owner.{avatarUrl, isVerified, rating, reviewCount}, location, verifiedOnly, sort, multi-value categoryId.
acceptance_criteria: Owner rating/reviewCount computed via Review aggregate where subjectId = owner (not a stored field) · owner with zero reviews returns rating: null, reviewCount: 0 · only PUBLISHED listings returned · response matches contract exactly (this is the endpoint the frontend is already built against — mismatches will surface immediately in hulurent-frontend).

title: feat(backend): implement availability endpoints (POST, GET, DELETE)
acceptance_criteria: POST/DELETE require item ownership · GET is public, unpaginated.

title: feat(backend): implement bookings.state-machine.js
description: Single source of truth for legal status transitions — see ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2.
acceptance_criteria: Every legal transition documented in api-reference.md's Bookings section is allowed · every illegal transition (e.g. REQUESTED → COMPLETED) throws · unit tested exhaustively.
role: Backend (highest-risk module — assign your strongest backend person)

title: feat(backend): implement bookings.conflict-check.js
description: Row-locked (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) overlap check — the app-level half of the dual defense described in ARCHITECTURE.md §3.
acceptance_criteria: Two near-simultaneous booking requests for overlapping dates on the same item — only one succeeds · non-overlapping requests both succeed · unit tested for adjacent/same-day edge cases.

title: feat(backend): implement POST /bookings
acceptance_criteria: 409 ConflictError on overlap, identical response body whether caught by BE-23's app-level check or the DB's exclusion_violation (per ARCHITECTURE.md §3) · success response matches contract exactly.

title: feat(backend): implement GET /bookings/:id and GET /bookings/mine
acceptance_criteria: /mine requires role=owner|renter query param · /:id is 403 for non-participants.

title: feat(backend): implement booking transition endpoints (accept, reject, confirm, cancel)
acceptance_criteria: Each endpoint enforces the correct actor (owner vs. renter) per api-reference.md · each routes through the state machine (BE-22), never sets status directly.

title: feat(backend): implement agreement-template.js
description: Generates agreement terms JSON from booking data, must include the off-platform handoff clause from product/trust-and-liability.md §1 — this isn't optional boilerplate, it's the documented liability policy.
acceptance_criteria: Generated terms.offPlatformHandoffClause matches the disclosed policy text · terms include price, deposit, cancellation policy.

title: feat(backend): implement GET/POST agreement endpoints
acceptance_criteria: POST /accept sets the correct field (ownerAccepted/renterAccepted) based on caller's role on the booking · versioning works (new row, never in-place update).

title: feat(backend): implement inspection scheduling endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Confirm can only be called by the party who didn't request it · matches all three documented endpoints.

title: feat(backend): implement REST messaging endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Only conversation participants can read/post · pagination works, oldest-first.

title: feat(backend): implement messaging.socket.js real-time delivery
description: Persistence still goes through the same repository as the REST endpoint — a dropped socket connection must never mean a lost message.
acceptance_criteria: Message sent via REST also emits to the other participant's socket in real time · message is in the DB even if the recipient's socket is disconnected.
role: Backend (this is the schedule's designated first cut if the team falls behind — see schedule.md)

title: feat(backend): implement evidence.upload.js
acceptance_criteria: Validates file type/size, pushes to object storage, returns references only (never raw files) to the service layer.

title: feat(backend): implement evidence submission and acknowledgement endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Only booking participants can submit/acknowledge · type must be PICKUP or RETURN · acknowledgement sets the correct field for the other party, not the submitter.

title: feat(backend): implement review submission and fetch endpoints
acceptance_criteria: 409 if booking isn't COMPLETED or already reviewed by this author (@@unique([bookingId, authorId])) · public fetch by user works.

title: feat(backend): implement report filing endpoint
acceptance_criteria: Requires auth · subjectId optional · returns 201 per contract.

title: feat(backend): implement admin report moderation endpoints
acceptance_criteria: ADMIN-only (BE-04) · every status change writes an AuditEvent via audit.service.js, not optional.

title: feat(backend): implement audit.service.js
description: No routes — called internally from other services.
acceptance_criteria: Callable from admin.service.js · writes a correctly-shaped AuditEvent row.

title: feat(backend): implement admin user restriction endpoint
acceptance_criteria: ADMIN-only · writes an audit event · returns the documented shape.

title: feat(backend): implement notifications endpoints
acceptance_criteria: GET paginated, newest-first · PATCH .../read requires ownership.

title: chore(backend): implement expire-pending-bookings job + scheduler
acceptance_criteria: A REQUESTED booking older than the configured window transitions to EXPIRED automatically · scheduler runs on an interval without blocking the main event loop.

title: test(backend): unit tests for bookings.state-machine.js and conflict-check.js
acceptance_criteria: Every state transition (legal and illegal) covered · overlap edge cases (adjacent, same-day) covered.

title: test(backend): integration tests for auth flow
acceptance_criteria: Register → login → /me → logout covered end-to-end against a test DB.

title: test(backend): integration tests for listings and search
test(backend): end-to-end test for the full rental lifecycle
description: Register → list → book → agree → pickup evidence → return evidence → complete → review, matching the MVP completion criterion in README.md.

title: chore(backend): security pass — verify authorize/ownership-guard on every mutating route
description: A checklist cross-referencing every PATCH/POST/DELETE route in api-reference.md against its middleware chain — none missing an auth check that the doc says it needs.
acceptance_criteria: A checklist cross-referencing every PATCH/POST/DELETE route in api-reference.md against its middleware chain — none missing an auth check that the doc says it needs.
role: Backend Lead (do this yourself, don't delegate — it's the last line of defense)
